about: Android must work 100% without Google services (IMPLEMENTATION §4). test/google-free.test.ts fails on any npm package below in the shipped dependency tree, or imported outside src/optional/google/ (code there loads only when Play services are detected). scripts/check-google-free.sh fails on any Maven group below in the resolved Gradle tree. Each entry says why.

npm.why: Crashlytics; crash reporting is none or self-hosted
Google Sign-In; sign-in is email and password plus TOTP
its Android push path is FCM (firebase-messaging); push is UnifiedPush plus local notifications
uses the Play services fused location provider; location goes through LocationManager
Play review and billing APIs; no in-app purchases

maven.why: Google telemetry transport used by Firebase and ML Kit
ML Kit; review before allowing (bundled models work offline but ship Google telemetry)
